claim: For workloads that are inflexible, stateful, fault-intolerant or tightly coupled, AWS strongly discourages using Spot Instances, and also discourages attempting to fail over to On-Demand Instances to handle interruptions or periods of unavailability.
question: Does AWS recommend failing over from Spot to On-Demand Instances to handle interruptions?

values.display: attempting to fail over to On-Demand Instances
values.spoken: AWS strongly discourages failing over from Spot to On-Demand

evidence.quote: We strongly discourage using Spot Instances for these workloads or attempting to fail over to On-Demand Instances to handle interruptions or periods of unavailability.
